title: Unlock All
script:
run_on_thread(getactorthreads()[1], [[
    local require = getrenv().shared.require

    local PlayerDataUtils = require("PlayerDataUtils")

    PlayerDataUtils.ownsWeapon = function()
        return true
    end

    PlayerDataUtils.ownsAttachment = function()
        return true
    end

    PlayerDataUtils.ownsWeaponSkin = function()
        return true
    end
]])
